criteria.question: Is the latest BMI 30 to under 45?
criteria.original_text: Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥30.0 kg/m^2 to <45.0 kg/m^2 at screening

criteria.question: Is the latest BMI 27 or higher with hypertension, dyslipidemia, prediabetes, sleep apnea, coronary artery disease, heart failure or cerebrovascular disease?
criteria.original_text: BMI ≥27.0 kg/m^2 at screening with at least 1 of the following weight-related co-morbidities: Hypertension, Dyslipidemia, Prediabetes, established Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA), established Coronary Artery Disease (CAD), Heart failure, established cerebrovascular disease

criteria.question: Has the patient ever been diagnosed with type 1 or type 2 diabetes?
criteria.original_text: Previous or current diagnosis of Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes at screening

criteria.question: Did body weight change by more than 5 kg in about the last 3 months?
criteria.original_text: Change in body weight >5 kg within approximately 3 months before screening

criteria.question: Has the patient had bariatric surgery, or a revision, reversal or removal of one?
criteria.original_text: Bariatric surgery, including any procedures to revise, reverse, or remove any previous bariatric surgery interventions

criteria.question: Has the patient had acute or chronic pancreatitis, cholecystitis or symptomatic gallstones?
criteria.original_text: History of acute or chronic pancreatitis, cholecystitis, or symptomatic gallbladder stones

criteria.question: Has the patient had medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2?
criteria.original_text: History of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2

criteria.question: Is there a family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2?
criteria.original_text: family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2

criteria.question: Does the patient meet the other protocol-defined criteria?
criteria.original_text: Other Protocol Defined Inclusion/ Exclusion Criteria Apply
